title: nnU-Net
paper_title: nnU-Net: a self-configuring method for deep learning-based biomedical image segmentation
core_mech: dataset fingerprint 驱动的自配置、交叉验证与推理后处理闭环，而不是单一新算子。
core_mech_en: Dataset-fingerprint-driven self-configuration, 5-fold cross-validation ensembling, and post-processing loop rather than a new neural block.
input_desc: 带影像、标签与 spacing 元数据的新分割数据集
input_en: New medical segmentation dataset with raw images, masks, and physical voxel spacing metadata
output_desc: 经交叉验证选择和后处理的可复现分割系统
output_en: Self-configured, cross-validated, and post-processed end-to-end segmentation system

source.title: nnU-Net
notes: The current repository contains nnU-Net v2; the linked Nature Methods paper describes the earlier system. Select the paper-matched branch/configuration before claiming original-method reproduction.

gaps: nnU-Net includes dataset fingerprinting, automatic planning, preprocessing, training and inference. A generic U-Net is not the system; the present upstream default is v2, so the paper-matched version and full pipeline must be selected.
